comment: Targets that are built and tested on every run but are not required (the macOS ones: see the workflow matrix). A candidate is published whenever its native build, whole test suite and extracted-archive acceptance all pass in that run. An entry is added here, keyed by platform, only for a MEASURED blocker that keeps a candidate from passing; publish.py prints it beside the run's own reason. There is none at present: macOS arm64 has been published since release 1.4505, and macOS Intel was missing from 1.4510 only because the upload of its built, tested and packaged archive failed (ENOTFOUND in upload-artifact, workflow run 38218905516), so it was never accepted.
